notes: §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR4: 'Any necessary conversion of data from one form of internal representation to another takes place during legal elementary moves', with a) alignment/space fill and no sign or de-editing into alphanumeric receivers, b) decimal-point alignment, de-editing, sign rules 1-2 and 3) an alphanumeric sender (GR3: 'All other figurative constants belong to the category alphanumeric') 'moved as if the sending operand were described as an unsigned numeric integer', c) alphabetic justification. One emitter serves every edition: MoveEmitter.ElementaryStore dispatches on MoveClassifier.Kind to ConvertSource (CharacterStore/SendingCharacters for character receivers; NumericRenderer.AlnumNum/CobolNum.FromAlphanumericSending and CobolEdit.DeEdit for numeric ones) or FigurativeToNumericImageStore. The prior PARTIAL's three faults are gone at --std 85: digit-only ALL into 999V99 gives 555.00 (as the PIC X(5) item does), into ZZ9.99 is edited (555.00), and QUOTE/HIGH-VALUE/ALL "AB" into COMP and COMP-3 run (undefined value, no abort). Also probed: signed, trailing/leading separate, P-scaled senders into X and JUSTIFIED X, alphanumeric-edited (and onto itself), alphabetic truncate/fill, signed into unsigned, COMP into COMP-3, CR and $ edited senders de-edited into signed/unsigned/edited, 18-digit negative, ALL "12"/ALL "123" into noninteger, ZERO into edited and X. The witness runs three of these moves. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming kb/Work PB426 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5176 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-08.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-08-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 GR4: conversion 'takes place during legal elementary moves, along with any editing specified for' the receiver, with no exception for a sender and receiver that are the same item, and §1985:VI.6.4.5 makes overlap undefined only when the items 'are not defined by the same data description entry'. §2023:14.9.25.4 GR6 b) 1: when the sending and receiving operands reference the same data item, 'If the category of the operand is alphanumeric-edited or national-edited, the result of execution of the statement is undefined'. MOVE X TO X of an alphanumeric-edited X was defined (editing) in 1985 and is undefined in 2023: a result made undefined. The rest (sign, separate sign, 'P', usage conversion, signed/unsigned receivers, alphanumeric sender as an unsigned integer) recurs in GR6 a) and d); the de-editing provisions in §2023:14.9.25.4 GR5 ('De-editing takes place only when the sending operand is a numeric-edited data item'). The 31-position cap cannot alter an 18-digit 1985 receiver.
